dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: A bulletin board put up by the Tenryou Commission, similar to the ones in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Kujou Sara's message:

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara's Message
dialogues.text: "Caution: A group of itinerant youths who call themselves the Arataki Gang are hosting an event of unknown purpose at this location. Please exercise caution, stay safe, and keep your personal belongings with you at all times."

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Sara's Message
dialogues.text: "Please report any illegal activity to the Tenryou Commission immediately."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yoimiya's message:

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya's Message
dialogues.text: "I was surprised to find someone hosting a festival tucked away in a little corner of this island, especially a new festival that I'd never heard of. The view here is amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya's Message
dialogues.text: "Although it's not the liveliest of festivals, it's magical in its own way."

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya's Message
dialogues.text: "Go, go, Arataki Gang! Let me know in advance next time and I'll get you some fireworks, free of charge!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aratani's message:

dialogues.speaker: Aratani's Message
dialogues.text: "When I first heard that someone wanted to rent Ms. Hina's advertising board, I refused. But the offer was very generous, so I thought I'd at least pay a visit to the site first."

dialogues.speaker: Aratani's Message
dialogues.text: "The moment I arrived at the venue, I was deeply touched. Even with such a tight budget and a miserable venue..."

dialogues.speaker: Aratani's Message
dialogues.text: "...the organizers still managed to reserve enough budget for Ms. Hina. Surely, this is true love? I signed the rental contract immediately."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Message from "TCG Buddy Ayato":

dialogues.speaker: Message from "TCG Buddy Ayato"
dialogues.text: "I've been playing trading card games with my friend Itto for a long time. He always loses, but he never gives up. I find his resilience truly admirable."

dialogues.speaker: Message from "TCG Buddy Ayato"
dialogues.text: "I was delighted to hear about my friend's festival today. I came here with a limited edition Genius Invokation TCG gift pack to offer my congratulations. I wish him a fantastic festival."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thoma's message:

dialogues.speaker: Thoma's Message
dialogues.text: "Hey, bro! Haven't seen you since the Irodori Festival. I hope you're doing well. I didn't know you were gonna be hosting a huge festival — you sure kept that quiet! Nice work!"

dialogues.speaker: Thoma's Message
dialogues.text: "If you ever wanna host another festival in the future, feel free to come and discuss it with me first. If you need a venue or furnishings or anything else, I'll see what I can do. Everything's negotiable!"

dialogues.speaker: Thoma's Message
dialogues.text: "By the way, I know you like beetle fighting, and I remembered that I had a couple of King Onikabuto at home. I left them on the wooden box over there. Enjoy!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Message from "Ramen Buddy":

dialogues.speaker: Message from "Ramen Buddy"
dialogues.text: "What a lovely surprise. I didn't think the mighty Arataki Itto would still remember his old ramen buddy."

dialogues.speaker: Message from "Ramen Buddy"
dialogues.text: "A glorious drumming festival on a deserted little island. It'd be a pity to miss out on such an interesting event."

dialogues.speaker: Message from "Ramen Buddy"
dialogues.text: "So of course, the moment I received your invitation, I couldn't get myself here fast enough."

dialogues.speaker: Message from "Ramen Buddy"
dialogues.text: "In order to show my gratitude, I brought you a free all-you-can-eat ramen voucher for Yukio's food stall. I'm sure you can come up with some way to thank me."

dialogues.speaker: Message from "Ramen Buddy"
dialogues.text: "By the way, I should mention — the voucher is only valid for the Fried Tofu meal deal."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Kimura's message:

dialogues.speaker: Kimura's Message
dialogues.text: "Recently, Madam Kujou let it slip that the Drumalong Festival on Amakane Island was quite interesting. My coworkers and I got curious, so we stopped by after work to check it out."

dialogues.speaker: Kimura's Message
dialogues.text: "We were more than a little surprised to find that it was the work of the Arataki Gang, who we evicted from Ritou just a few days ago. So they actually pulled it off, they're hosting a festival. Good for them, I say."

dialogues.speaker: Kimura's Message
dialogues.text: "Sure, it's a very small-scale festival, but it's a first step. Keep at it, you guys. I hope to see more of this from you in the future."

dialogues.speaker: Kimura's Message
dialogues.text: "P.S. Roasted Lavender Melon — surprisingly good!"

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: A new, attention-grabbing notice has appeared on the Tenryou Commission's bulletin board.

dialogues.speaker: Tenryou Commission Announcement
dialogues.text: "Due to Arataki Itto's unacceptable behavior, the Drumalong Festival bearing his name and hosted by him is hereby suspended with immediate effect. The reopening date is yet to be determined."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: More...

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: The unparalleled Beetle-battling competition "Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl" is upon us!

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: All are welcome to watch this exciting Beetle showdown on the island to the northwest of Araumi.

dialogues.speaker: Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Come and witness the crowning moment of Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King wiping the floor with Grandmaster Hanakado!
